title: juncus acutus var. effusus
intro: Juncus acutus var. effusus, commonly known as the Needle Spikerush, is a type of aquatic plant belonging to the Juncaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Needle Spikerush include reducing inflammation, fighting bacterial infections, and exhibiting antihyperglycemic activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
